critic.fix_suggestion: Add 4 vertical rectangular primitives to the fuselage side profile to represent main cabin doors. Position these at 15-degree intervals along the window line, with a height of 0.8x the window row and a width of 0.12x the total fuselage length. Ensure each rectangle has a slight inward offset (0.02 units) from the surface to create a visible break in the continuous window primitive sequence.
